name: CIDR calculator
summary: Subnet range, mask, hosts from CIDR
author: friday-core
description: IPv4 subnet maths from a CIDR such as 192.168.1.0/24 or an address with a mask: network, broadcast, mask, wildcard, first and last usable host, host count and the kind of range (private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, multicast, public). Also tells whether given addresses are inside the network. /31 and /32 are handled as the special cases they are.
